title: ant CLI — Official Anthropic Command-Line Client for the Claude API
description: Official Anthropic CLI (`ant`) for the Claude API. Three key capabilities: (1) Faster interaction with the Claude API from the terminal, (2) Native integration with Claude Code sessions, (3) Versioning of API resources (prompts, tools, configurations) in YAML files. Note from memory: need to verify whether ant CLI works on Max plan (keychain auth) or requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Registry notes Max plan uses 'claude -p' CLI for programmatic calls — ant CLI may offer a better path for API-level resource management.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry has 'claude -p' CLI for programmatic Claude calls, but not a dedicated API management CLI with YAML resource versioning. ant CLI appears to be for API resource management (prompts, tools, configs) not just sending messages. Functional gap exists.
